messages:
maria: Heads-up: we have a growing delta-lag for eu-agg (~6h behind). I opened a ticket and am trying to coordinate a replay window before the morning SLA check-in. Any objections to using the priority lane?

alex: No objections. What's the estimated queued size?

maria: Ticket #TI-4821 has the details. ~1.2M rows, expected replay runtime ~45m if we can give it 4 slots.

joel: 4 slots sounds fine. Are these deltas or full upserts? Need to check idempotency.

maria: Mostly deltas but there are a few late upserts from the ingest stream. We validated dedupe keys — should be safe.

tara: Do we want the replay to go through the console preflight (dry-run) first? Last time we saw unexpected schema drift after a dry-run pass.

maria: Good call. Suggest: dry-run -> small canary (100k rows) -> full priority lane replay. Need an operator to approve the canary failure threshold.

sam: I'm +1 for canary. Also suggest `--skip-joins` flag for the canary to avoid heavy downstream reshuffles. If canary looks good, run full with joins on.

joel: Agree. Also can we route the replay to eu-nonprod first to sanity-check observability traces and histogram deltas?

maria: We only have a 2h window before SLA review. If we route to nonprod then prod it doubles time. Proposal: run canary in prod but at low concurrency and `X-telemetry=canary` header so console shows separate metrics.

alex: Is that header respected by the console dashboards? I thought metrics aggregation flattens headers into tags, but we do have a `telemetry_group` dimension now.

maria: Yes the console shows `telemetry_group` in the reprocess dashboard. I can add a temporary filter named "delta_ticket_TI-4821".

infra-bot: replay-job-ctrl: scheduled replay 9876 (canary) by @maria -> status: queued

ci-bot: ci: canary job 9876 started on replay-worker-3 (slot 12)

tara: When can we toggle preempt? If the canary blows up we should have automatic fallback to previous aggregates. Need a rollback plan.

sam: Rollback plan: 1) pause replay queue 2) call `aggregate-restore --point-in-time=PRE_REPLAY` 3) re-run dedupe-only pass for affected keys. I've got a runbook snippet.

maria: Copy paste runbook in the ticket? Also we should mark the run in the console with a note so Optimize can pick up cost/quality delta.

alex: One more ask: add quota bump for this ticket only. The default quota throttler will slow to 1 slot/tenant. Can product approve a temporary bump to 4 slots?

joel: Product isn't in this channel, but I can ping @product-ops.

maria: pinged them in TI-4821, awaiting ack. If product doesn't respond in 10m we should still proceed with a conservative 2-slot canary.

infra-bot: replay-job-ctrl: canary 9876 -> running -> logs: `processed 23k rows / 100k target`

maria: Observability update: console shows small uptick in lag-variance but no error spikes.

sam: If canary hits >5% error we abort. Keep an eye on `agg-regression-rate` and token-level cost.

ci-bot: ci: canary job 9876 finished -> status: success -> processed 100k rows in 7m

maria: Canary success. Product approved quota bump in the ticket. Moving to full priority lane replay with 4 slots. Starting in 2m.

alex: I'll watch console graphs (latency, error, delta-counts) and be on standby for rollback.

joel: I'll queue the `aggregate-restore` command just in case and leave it paused.

maria: Kickoff now: replay-job-ctrl: scheduled replay 9877 (full) by @maria -> params: `--ticket=TI-4821 --priority=delta-lane --slots=4`

infra-bot: replay-job-ctrl: replay 9877 -> running -> started at 5328001246

maria: Quick reminder for postmortem: annotate the console run with the ticket id, affected cohorts, and any quality diffs. We want this in Optimize signals.

sam: Noted. Also we'll add a transient dashboard panel for `canary_vs_full_regression` so it's easier to compare.

ci-bot: ci: replay 9877 progress -> processed 600k / 1.2M rows (ETA ~22m)

tara: If we start seeing increased join latency, can we throttle by tenant? There's an emergency throttling endpoint: `POST /api/internal/throttle` with body { "tenant": "all", "rate": "0.5" }.

maria: Thanks. If we need to throttle, call it out here and I'll execute.

[~20 minutes later]

infra-bot: replay-job-ctrl: replay 9877 finished -> status: success -> total time 41m

maria: Done. Aggregates reconciled; console shows baseline delta <0.2% for core cohorts. Closing TI-4821 after a short verification window.

alex: Great run. Can we add a small UX tweak to the console: show `ticket:` as a first-class filter on reprocess runs? Makes triage faster.

maria: Filing a follow-up RFC for console-ux: ticket-filter and run annotations.

joel: Also request: surface `preflight-diff` summary in the job list row so you don't have to open the run to see small vs large diffs.

maria: Agreed. I'll include both items in the RFC.

sam: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
